items.title: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.title_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统研究综述
items.summary_zh: 大语言模型智能体操作系统,也叫智能体操作系统,是整合大模型、工具资源以及多智能体协同的核心平台,目前正逐渐成为推动通用人工智能发展的一个关键研究方向。对智能体操作系统领域的研究进展进行了系统梳理,首先从基础理论着手,回顾了多种大模型的演进情况以及智能体和传统操作系统领域的进展;接着,围绕典型体系结构,如AIOS等,阐述了其分层架构与模块化设计是怎样达成资源管理与智能调度的。进一步地,明确了当前智能体操作系统在上下文整合、扩展性以及安全性等方面面临的技术挑战,同时也提出了未来借助轻量化设计、自监督学习机制以及动态调度算法来提升多智能体协作效率。该研究的主要贡献为,将那些分散的研究给予整合,促使技术框架变得更为明晰,并指出了智能体操作系统对新兴体系以及行业定制化实践覆盖不全面的情况。未来的研究需要侧重推动跨域智能体操作系统自我进化的能力,并且加快其在各个领域的落地等。

extra.description: 大语言模型智能体操作系统,也叫智能体操作系统,是整合大模型、工具资源以及多智能体协同的核心平台,目前正逐渐成为推动通用人工智能发展的一个关键研究方向。对智能体操作系统领域的研究进展进行了系统梳理,首先从基础理论着手,回顾了多种大模型的演进情况以及智能体和传统操作系统领域的进展;接着,围绕典型体系结构,如AIOS等,阐述了其分层架构与模块化设计是怎样达成资源管理与智能调度的。进一步地,明确了当前智能体操作系统在上下文整合、扩展性以及安全性等方面面临的技术挑战,同时也提出了未来借助轻量化设计、自监督学习机制以及动态调度算法来提升多智能体协作效率。该研究的主要贡献为,将那些分散的研究给予整合,促使技术框架变得更为明晰,并指出了智能体操作系统对新兴体系以及行业定制化实践覆盖不全面的情况。未来的研究需要侧重推动跨域智能体操作系统自我进化的能力,并且加快其在各个领域的落地等。

items.title: Federated Community Detection in Bipartite Networks
items.title_zh: 二部网络中的联邦社区检测
items.summary_zh: 我们研究当大矩阵在无法共享原始数据的服务器间水平分区时的联邦谱估计。我们提出FLICKER，一种针对特定目标的基于梯度的幂迭代方法，仅使用本地块上的矩阵-向量乘积来恢复与指定谱目标相关的奇异方向。不同目标方向可以独立且并行地恢复。我们建立了非渐近收敛保证，并提供了一种用于谱目标选择的递归网格搜索程序。基于FLICKER，我们开发了用于二部网络中联邦社区检测的BiFLICKER，以及用于邻近或重复奇异方向的顺序投影变体。在稀疏二部随机块模型下，我们证明来自参考服务器的适当重新缩放的前导奇异值提供有效的全局目标，并且Sequential BiFLICKER在更强稀疏条件下实现消失的误聚类率和精确恢复。模拟表明，当本地样本量较小时，BiFLICKER接近集中式谱聚类，并且比现有联邦谱基线更稳健。在按国家自然分区的LastFM用户-艺术家网络上，Sequential BiFLICKER相对于集中式

extra.description: We study federated spectral estimation when a large matrix is horizontally partitioned across servers that cannot share raw data. We propose FLICKER, a target-specific gradient-based power iteration that recovers a singular direction associated with a prescribed spectral target using only matrix-vector products on local blocks. Different target directions can be recovered independently and in parallel. We establish non-asymptotic convergence guarantees and provide a recursive grid-search procedure for spectral target selection. Building on FLICKER, we develop BiFLICKER for federated community detection in bipartite networks, together with a sequential projected variant for nearby or repeated singular directions. Under a sparse bipartite stochastic block model, we show that properly rescaled leading singular values from a reference server provide valid global targets, and that Sequential BiFLICKER achieves a vanishing misclustering rate and exact recovery under stronger sparsity conditions. Simulations show that BiFLICKER remains close to centralized spectral clustering and is more robust than existing federated spectral baselines when local sample sizes are small. On a LastFM user-artist network naturally partitioned by country, Sequential BiFLICKER attains an overall ARI of 0.94 against centralized clustering while revealing cross-country communities with distinct listening profiles.

items.title: AnyGoal: On World Model Generalization Beyond Expert Rollouts
items.title_zh: AnyGoal：论世界模型超越专家轨迹的泛化
items.summary_zh: 世界模型的目标是捕捉环境的动态。这具有很大的吸引力，因为它允许智能体借助世界模型来规划和模拟行动方案。然而，为了使这些用途可靠，学习到的动态必须在专家轨迹中观察到的特定状态-动作组合之外表现良好。尽管如此，数据覆盖、动态泛化和下游规划性能之间的关系仍未得到充分探索。我们通过组合泛化的视角研究这种关系：世界模型能否将熟悉的状态和动作因素重新组合成有效的动态？为了回答这个问题，我们引入了AnyGoal，一个由广泛使用的世界模型环境构建的目标偏移任务变体基准，以及一个开源库。每个任务都被设计为在学习到基础动态的世界模型能力范围内：个体状态因素和动作保持在其训练支持范围内，但它们的组合在专家轨迹中代表性不足。在多个环境和世界模型家族中，我们发现当前模型在这些重新组合下始终表现出失败。通过检查跨模型家族、交互机制和评估指标的动态和表示失败，我们研究了当前世界模型在哪里泛化以及目标偏移预测和规划仍面临

extra.description: The goal of a world model is to capture the dynamics of an environment. This has the great appeal that it allows agents to plan and simulate a course of actions with the help of a world model. For these uses to be reliable, however, the learned dynamics must behave well beyond the specific state-action combinations observed in expert rollouts. Despite this, the relationship between data coverage, dynamics generalization, and downstream planning performance remains underexplored. We study this relationship through the lens of compositional generalization: can a world model recombine familiar state and action factors into valid dynamics? To answer this, we introduce AnyGoal, a benchmark of goal-shifted task variants built from widely used world-model environments, together with an open-source library. Each task is designed to be within reach of a world model that has learned the underlying dynamics: individual state factors and actions remain within their training support, but their combinations are underrepresented in expert trajectories. Across multiple environments and world model families, we find that current models consistently exhibit failures under these recombinations. By examining dynamics and representation failures across model families, interaction regimes, and evaluation metrics, we study where current world models generalize and where challenges remain for goal-shifted prediction and planning. Together, this framework, benchmark, and analysis provide a basis for evaluating progress toward world models that generalize to new planning tasks.

items.title: Local data augmentation for imbalanced binary classification
items.title_zh: 用于不平衡二分类的局部数据增强
items.summary_zh: 面对不平衡二分类，我们旨在最大化召回率，同时限制少数类中误检的比例。为此，本工作研究了几种重平衡策略的效果，从对少数类观测进行均匀子采样，到更复杂的局部数据增强方案。更具体地说，我们确定仅重平衡类别比例不能改变分类性能，而局部数据增强被证明对最终结果有影响。局部增强方案通过两步程序引入。第一步在训练观测中随机子采样锚点。这些锚点在第二步中用于按照待指定的“增强核”抽取新的增强数据。这使我们能够将锚点子采样的影响与抽取增强数据（是否考虑支持的局部几何结构）的影响解耦。在合成数据上的实验说明了结合高斯或基于扩散的增强核的几种锚点子采样策略的实际性能。与类似SMOTE的数据增强程序相比，在分类边界附近子采样并结合高斯增强核时获得更好的性能。此外，在支持几何结构重要的特定设置中，实验结果表明使用基于扩散的增强核优于高斯核。

extra.description: Facing imbalanced binary classification, we aim at maximizing the recall while limiting the proportion of false detections in the minority class. For doing that, the present work studies the effect of several rebalancing strategies, from the uniform subsampling of the observations from the minority class, to a more involved local data augmentation scheme. To be more specific, we establish that only rebalancing class proportions cannot modify the classification performance, whereas local data augmentation is proved to have an impact on the final results. The local augmentation scheme is introduced by means of a two-step procedure. The first step randomly subsamples anchor points among the training observations. These anchor points are used in the second step, for drawing new augmentation data following an ''augmentation kernel'' to be specified. This enables us to decouple the impact of the anchor points subsampling from the one of drawing augmentation data accounting (or not) for the local geometry of the support. The experiments on synthetic data illustrate the practical performance of several strategies for subsampling anchor points combined with either a Gaussian or a diffusion-based augmentation kernel. Compared to SMOTE-like data augmentation procedures, a better performance is achieved when subsampling in the close neighborhood to the classification boundary combined with a Gaussian augmentation kernel. Furthermore in specific settings where the geometric structure of the support matters, the experimental results show that using a diffusion-based augmentation kernel outperforms the Gaussian one.

items.title: Lef1 Promotes Foxi1-Dependent Ionocyte Specification by Airway Submucosal Gland Progenitors
items.title_zh: Lef1通过气道黏膜下腺祖细胞促进Foxi1依赖性离子细胞特化
items.summary_zh: 肺离子细胞是含黏膜下腺（SMG）气道中的稀有细胞，被认为具有调节气道表面液体和黏液组成的专门离子转运特性。肺离子细胞的起源仍不清楚，但它们与气道SMG的关联表明它们可能起源于该区室中的特化祖细胞。我们证明小鼠腺体肌上皮细胞（GMEC）具有独特能力来特化富含Cftr通道的离子细胞。Lef1转录因子在小鼠气管、3D类器官和/或气液界面（ALI）培养中对于GMEC特化离子细胞既是必要的也是充分的。在GMEC中过表达Lef1（Lef1OE）产生富含离子细胞的上皮，具有增强的Cftr介导的氯离子、碳酸氢盐和液体转运特性。此外，在Lef1OE GMEC中敲除Foxi1阻止了离子细胞形成，同时促进表达Cftr的分泌细胞特化。这些发现为离子细胞与SMG解剖关联提供了祖细胞关系，并为协调特化表达CFTR的离子细胞和分泌细胞提供了转录框架。

extra.description: Pulmonary ionocytes are rare cells in submucosal gland (SMG)-containing airways thought to have specialized ion transport properties that regulate airway surface fluid and mucus composition. The origins of pulmonary ionocytes remain unclear, but their association with airway SMGs suggests they may arise from specialized progenitors in this compartment. We show that mouse glandular myoepithelial cells (GMECs) have a unique capacity to specify ionocytes enriched in the Cftr channel. The Lef1 transcription factor was both necessary and sufficient to promote GMEC specification of ionocytes in mouse trachea, 3D organoids, and/or air-liquid interface (ALI) cultures. Overexpression of Lef1 (Lef1OE) in GMECs produced ionocyte-enriched epithelia with enhanced Cftr-mediated chloride, bicarbonate, and fluid transport properties. Moreover, Foxi1 knockout in Lef1OE GMECs prevented ionocyte formation while promoting specification of Cftr-expressing secretory cells. These findings provide a progenitor relationship for the anatomical association of ionocytes with SMGs and a transcriptional framework for coordinated specification of CFTR-expressing ionocytes and secretory cells.

items.title: gpuGEM: GPU-based linear optimisation of genome-scale metabolic models
items.title_zh: gpuGEM：基于GPU的基因组尺度代谢模型线性优化
items.summary_zh: 摘要：基因组尺度代谢模型在重复优化工作流中日益挑战CPU线性规划求解器。我们提出gpuGEM，一个使用NVIDIA cuOpt进行基于GPU的GEM优化的开源Python库，具有针对HiGHS和Gurobi验证的尺寸自适应设置。在涵盖四个数量级问题规模的十个模型基准套件中，gpuGEM相对于每个模型更快的HiGHS对偶单纯形和内点法实现了1.1倍至94倍的加速。gpuGEM在十个模型中的三个上也优于Gurobi，加速为1.6倍至2.5倍。在候选基因优先级工作流中，gpuGEM将端到端查询时间从41秒减少到21秒。可用性与实现：gpuGEM在MIT许可证下发布于https://github.com/Digital-Metabolic-Twin-Centre/gpuGEM和PyPI（pip install gpugem）。存档版本（v0.1.2）可在https://zenodo.org/rec

extra.description: Summary: Genome-scale metabolic models increasingly challenge CPU linear-programming solvers in repeated-optimisation workflows. We present gpuGEM, an open-source Python library for GPU-based GEM optimisation using NVIDIA cuOpt, with size-adaptive settings validated against HiGHS and Gurobi. Across a ten-model benchmark suite spanning four orders of magnitude in problem size, gpuGEM achieved speed-ups of 1.1x to 94x relative to the faster of the HiGHS dual-simplex and interior-point methods for each model. gpuGEM also outperformed Gurobi on three of ten models, with speed-ups of 1.6x to 2.5x. In a candidate-gene prioritisation workflow, gpuGEM reduced end-to-end query time from 41 s to 21 s. Availability and Implementation: gpuGEM is released under the MIT licence at https://github.com/Digital-Metabolic-Twin-Centre/gpuGEM and on PyPI (pip install gpugem). An archived release(v0.1.2) is available at https://zenodo.org/records/23422813. gpuGEM requires an NVIDIA GPU, Python 3.11 or later, CUDA 12 and cuOpt 26.6 or later. cuOpt requires a GPU with Volta architecture or newer (compute capability 7.0 or newer). Contact: ronan.mt.fleming@gmail.com Supplementary information: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

items.title: A Unified Framework for Batch Correction and Imputation in Modern Mass Spectrometry Proteomics
items.title_zh: 现代质谱蛋白质组学中批次校正与插补的统一框架
items.summary_zh: 基于质谱的蛋白质组学，包括单细胞应用，常受批次效应、实验室间变异和信号漂移的混杂影响，可能掩盖生物学解释。NMFBatch通过一个统一框架解决这些不期望的变异来源，该框架结合非负矩阵分解与广义加性建模，从蛋白质表达数据中联合捕获离散和连续技术效应。它通过掩码和即时插补直接处理缺失值。在参考数据集、血浆蛋白质组学队列、模拟和单细胞数据上的基准测试表明，NMFBatch减少了技术变异同时保留生物学结构。这些结果确立NMFBatch作为从蛋白质表达数据进行批次校正、协调和整合蛋白质组学分析的稳健框架。

extra.description: Mass spectrometry-based proteomics, including single-cell applications, are often confounded by batch effects, inter-laboratory variation, and signal drift that can obscure biological interpretation. NMFBatch addresses these sources of unwanted variation through a unified framework that combines non-negative matrix factorization with generalized additive modelling to jointly capture discrete and continuous technical effects from protein expression data. It handles missing values directly through masking and on-the-fly imputation. Benchmarking across reference datasets, plasma proteomics cohorts, simulations, and single-cell data demonstrated that NMFBatch reduced technical variation while preserving biological structure. These results establish NMFBatch as a robust framework for batch correction, harmonization, and integrative proteomics analysis from protein expression data.

items.title: OmicsBench: a long-horizon multi-turn benchmark of AI agents on research-study-scale bioinformatics
items.title_zh: OmicsBench：AI智能体在研究级生物信息学上的长时程多轮基准
items.summary_zh: 计算生物学家越来越多地将大量分析委托给AI智能体进行长时程、多轮会话，但大多数智能体生物信息学能力基准只提出单一短任务和单次提示。我们提出OmicsBench，一个面向AI智能体的长时程、多轮生物信息学基准。其97个任务各自将依赖子任务连接成有向无环图，总共662个底层子任务。每个子任务作为一个用户轮次提出，并针对答案键进行确定性评分，对错误答案提供可选的上下文反馈。在三种框架上的12个模型中，最慢的智能体平均每任务耗时3.6小时，没有任何组合接近饱和该基准，无上下文反馈时平均得分为0.43至0.57（满分1），有反馈时为0.54至0.67。多轮评估还揭示了单次提示无法发现的行为，因为智能体在依赖早期子任务的子任务上得分较低，而上下文反馈帮助智能体挽回部分损失。由于确定性评分无法定性说明智能体如何失败，我们还引入了一个无监督失败模式发现流程，用于描述、嵌入和聚类智能体的失败尝试，以揭示涌现

extra.description: Computational biologists increasingly delegate substantial analyses to AI agents in long-horizon, multi-turn sessions, yet most benchmarks of agents' bioinformatics capabilities pose a single short task with a single-shot prompt. We present OmicsBench, a long-horizon, multi-turn bioinformatics benchmark for AI agents. Each of its 97 tasks links dependent subtasks into a directed acyclic graph, for 662 underlying subtasks in all. Each subtask is posed as one user turn and graded deterministically against an answer key, with optional in-context feedback on incorrect answers. Across 12 models on three harnesses, the slowest agent averages 3.6 hours per task, and no combination comes near saturating the benchmark, with mean scores of 0.43 to 0.57 out of a possible 1 without in-context feedback and 0.54 to 0.67 with it. Multi-turn evaluation also uncovers behavior that single-shot prompts cannot, as agents score lower on subtasks that depend on earlier subtasks, and in-context feedback helps agents recover some of that loss. Because deterministic scoring gives no qualitative account of how an agent failed, we also introduce an unsupervised failure mode discovery pipeline that describes, embeds, and clusters agents' failed attempts to surface emergent failure modes. Applied to OmicsBench, this pipeline exposes qualitative shortcomings in how agents carry out bioinformatics analyses, ranging from agents applying their own statistical filters in place of the specified ones to agents writing whole answers from memory.

items.title: Truecell reproduces R Seurat's single-cell analysis outputs natively in the Python ecosystem
items.title_zh: Truecell 在 Python 生态中原生复现 R Seurat 的单细胞分析输出
items.summary_zh: 单细胞 RNA 测序分析主要使用 Seurat（R）或 Scanpy（Python），选择通常由编程语言偏好驱动。然而，默认情况下，这些工具产生不同的可变特征、邻居图、聚类和标记基因。需要 Python（支持大多数深度学习、基础模型和代理工具）的实验室必须在无法复现 Seurat 结果的框架中重新实现 Seurat 分析。Truecell 被开发为 Seurat 接口的 Python 实现，保留函数名称、参数、默认设置和对象模型，以促进分析的无缝转移。在十八个与 R Seurat 的配对端到端评估中，确定性输出匹配到浮点精度，并且折叠变化顺序在所有九个差异表达测试中相同。在三个数据集上的三臂基准测试中，固定用户参数和每个工具 20 个种子，Truecell 在所有 12 个数据集和分辨率设置组合中比配置 Seurat 的 Scanpy 更接近地复现 Seurat 的聚类。Truecell

extra.description: Single-cell RNA-sequencing analyses predominantly use either Seurat (R) or Scanpy (Python), with the choice often driven by programming language preference. However, by default, these tools produce divergent variable features, neighbour graphs, clusters, and marker genes. Laboratories requiring Python, which supports most deep-learning, foundation-model, and agent tools, must re-implement Seurat analyses in a framework that does not replicate Seurat's results. Truecell was developed as a Python implementation of the Seurat interface, preserving function names, arguments, default settings, and the object model to facilitate seamless transfer of analyses. In eighteen paired end-to-end evaluations against R Seurat, deterministic outputs matched to floating-point precision, and fold-change order was identical across all nine differential expression tests. In a three-arm benchmark on three datasets, with fixed user parameters and 20 seeds per tool, Truecell more closely reproduced Seurat's clustering than a Seurat-configured Scanpy in all 12 combinations of dataset and resolution settings. Truecell's marker genes and enriched pathways were also closer to Seurat's than Scanpy's were, and pseudobulk DESeq2 reproduced Seurat's gene lists with a Jaccard index ranging from 0.95 to 1.00. This agreement reflects fidelity to Seurat rather than biological correctness.

items.title: Reducing double-dipping in single-cell topic models with three-way count splitting
items.title_zh: 用三向计数拆分减少单细胞主题模型中的双重 dipping
items.summary_zh: 主题模型从单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）数据中学习基因程序，然后相同的计数被用于测试哪些基因和供体与这些程序相关。计数拆分是这种复用的标准补救措施，但当编码器读取每个细胞的计数时尚未被测试。在一个104,400细胞的狼疮队列中，每次运行300个置换零基因，朴素检验在名义5%水平下拒绝了36%的零基因-主题对，而通常的两向拆分拒绝了38%，因为编码器看到了被检验基因自身的留出计数。在单独的第三个计数上编码主题使用，使用beta-二项稀疏化，将此降低到7.7%（模型外基因为6.7%）；对于另外两个模型LDVAE和scETM，该率为7.0-7.3%（朴素为51-59%）。一个无标签干扰素程序在狼疮队列和预先指定的COVID-19队列的留出计数中发生偏移，供体水平主题使用预测疾病（AUROC 0.96），超越细胞类型比例（两个队列中分别为0.86和0.58）。校准和预测不依赖于模型。我们不

extra.description: Topic models learn gene programs from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data, and the same counts are then used to test which genes and donors are associated with those programs. Count splitting is the standard remedy for this reuse, but it has not been tested when an encoder reads each cell's counts. On a 104,400-cell lupus cohort with 300 permuted null genes per run, naive tests rejected 36% of null gene-topic pairs at a nominal 5% level, and the usual two-way split rejected 38%, because the encoder sees the tested gene's own held-out count. Encoding topic usage on a separate third of the counts, with beta-binomial thinning, lowered this to 7.7% (6.7% for genes outside the model); for two other models, LDVAE and scETM, the rate was 7.0-7.3% (naive 51-59%). A label-free interferon program shifts in held-out counts in the lupus cohort and in a pre-specified COVID-19 cohort, and donor-level topic usage predicts disease (AUROC 0.96) beyond cell-type proportions (0.86 and 0.58 in the two cohorts). Calibration and prediction did not depend on the model. We do not claim better clustering, prediction or topic stability. Code, figures and result tables are public (MIT license; DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23307193).

items.title: Understanding Gene Expression-to-Image Learning: Spatial Structure and Information Fidelity
items.title_zh: 理解基因表达到图像学习：空间结构与信息保真度
items.summary_zh: 单细胞RNA测序（scRNA-seq）使生物异质性的细胞水平分析成为可能，但从高维、无序基因表达谱学习有效表示仍具挑战性。基因表达到图像（GE2I）通过将基因值排列在像素网格上供卷积神经网络使用，提供了一种有效学习策略，但其潜在机制仍不清楚。我们在全转录组数据上研究GE2I，同时保持网络和训练过程固定。我们的结果揭示了空间平滑性与基因级保真度之间的权衡。结构化映射产生平滑的低频模式，支持更快的早期优化，而将多个基因分配到同一像素会模糊表达差异并可能降低预测性能。这种权衡解释了为什么当表示许多基因时，随机映射可以与结构化布局竞争。即使图像平滑性降低，一对一基因到像素分配在测试的视觉骨干网络中也能改善预测。我们进一步发现预训练和增强的益处取决于骨干网络和映射。这些发现为像素分配和将视觉先验迁移到基因表达数据提供了实用指导。

extra.description: Single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) enables cell-level analysis of biological heterogeneity, but learning effective representations from high-dimensional, unordered gene expression profiles remains challenging. Gene Expression-to-Image (GE2I) offers an effective learning strategy by arranging gene values on pixel grids for convolutional neural networks, but its underlying mechanisms remain unclear. We study GE2I on full-transcriptome data while keeping the network and training procedure fixed. Our results reveal a trade-off between spatial smoothness and gene-level fidelity. Structured mappings produce smooth, low-frequency patterns that support faster early optimization, whereas assigning multiple genes to the same pixel obscures expression differences and can reduce predictive performance. This trade-off explains why random mappings can compete with structured layouts when many genes are represented. One-to-one gene-to-pixel assignment improves prediction across the tested visual backbones even when image smoothness decreases. We further find that the benefits of pretraining and augmentation depend on the backbone and mapping. These findings provide practical guidance for pixel allocation and the transfer of vision priors to gene expression data.

items.title: Predictive Multiplicity in Cell-Fate Assignment: Label-Free Rashomon Sets and the Limits of Per-Cell Certification
items.title_zh: 细胞命运分配中的预测多重性：无标签 Rashomon 集和逐细胞认证的局限
items.summary_zh: 单细胞轨迹推断将转录组测量映射到发育连续体上，但同样拟合数据的配置可能分配冲突的细胞命运。FateMultiplicity 是一个无标签框架，通过评估交叉拟合留出基因上的模型差异，在非劣效性测试下针对随机种子变异进行校准，构建统计可接受的模型集或 Rashomon 集，无需谱系标签。多重性很大，更多取决于模型空间的多样性而非其大小：第二个算法的十二种配置暴露 20.0% 的细胞，而第一个算法的二十四种配置暴露 3.8%。然后测试逐细胞认证命运边际 FM 是否比拟合模型已提供的产生更可靠的分配，结果并非如此。在模拟真实值上，在相同细胞上，FM 以 AUC 0.682 区分错误分配，而基线配置自身的决策边际为 0.965（p = 0.003），种子离散基线为 0.854。信息量由所接纳集的广度而非其基数决定：在基数四时，种子重拟合给出 0.933，超参数扰动集给出 0.701。将下确界放宽到

extra.description: Single-cell trajectory inference maps transcriptomic measurements onto developmental continua, yet configurations that fit the data equally well can assign conflicting cell fates. FateMultiplicity is a label-free framework that constructs a statistically admissible model set, or Rashomon set, without lineage labels, by evaluating model discrepancy on cross-fitted held-out genes under non-inferiority testing calibrated against random-seed variation. Multiplicity is large and depends more on the diversity of the model space than its size: twelve configurations of a second algorithm expose 20.0% of cells where twenty-four of the first expose 3.8%. Whether the per-cell certified fate margin FM yields more reliable assignments than the fitted model already provides is then tested, and it does not. On simulation ground truth, on the same cells, FM discriminates misassignment at AUC 0.682, against 0.965 for the baseline configuration's own decision margin (p = 0.003) and 0.854 for a seed-dispersion baseline. Informativeness is governed by the breadth of the admitted set, not its cardinality: at cardinality four, seed refits give 0.933 and hyperparameter-perturbed sets 0.701. Relaxing the infimum to a q-quantile recovers discrimination but converges toward the single model's own confidence; the supremum reaches 0.973 because theta*'s membership bounds it from below, while the infimum is unanchored. Multiplicity in trajectory inference is worth measuring and reporting, but per-cell certification over a label-free Rashomon set is not a route to more reliable fate calls. Two constructions survive: a margin-erosion ratio separates real from spurious branch points in simulation (AUC 0.890, untested on real data), and against clonally observed fate, uncertified cells disagree with their clone's outcome 16.4 percentage points more often than certified cells (p < 0.001).

items.title: Protocol for Discovering Convergent Molecular Networks across Multi-Omics Datasets Using Network Propagation
items.title_zh: 使用网络传播跨多组学数据集发现趋同分子网络的方案
items.summary_zh: 表型结果源于分子层之间的协调变化。尽管多组学数据捕捉互补的分子信号，但由于基因水平重叠有限，将其整合为连贯的生物机制仍然具有挑战性。网络传播将每个数据集中的重要基因命中映射到先验知识分子相互作用网络上，并将其信号扩散到邻近基因。对传播网络进行数学整合，随后进行聚类和通路富集，可揭示共享分子网络，从而指出跨正交分子层捕捉到的核心生物学。

extra.description: Phenotypic outcomes arise from coordinated changes across molecular layers. Although multi-omics data capture complementary molecular signals, integrating them into coherent biological mechanisms remains challenging due to limited overlap at the gene level. Network propagation maps significant gene hits from each dataset onto a prior knowledge molecular interaction network and diffuses their signals to neighboring genes. Mathematical integration of propagated networks, followed by clustering and pathway enrichment, reveals shared molecular networks, pinpointing the core biology captured across orthogonal molecular layers.

items.title: OpenVLHarness: Real World Visual Agentic Tool-Use with Multimodal Memory
items.title_zh: OpenVLHarness：具有多模态记忆的真实世界视觉智能体工具使用
items.summary_zh: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）在视觉推理方面取得了快速进展，然而许多任务需要仅通过内部推理难以获得的证据：我们在22个基准上的对照研究表明，简单增加基础模型的推理预算仅产生适度增益。此类任务需要接地感知、外部知识以及通过异构工具获得的数值测量，其输出必须对模型可解释并在推理步骤间保留。我们介绍OpenVLHarness，一个围绕能力层和持久多模态记忆组织的多模态推理框架。能力层将任务级工具接口与证据渲染相结合，提供对异构后端的一致访问，并将其输出转换为模型可读的观测。持久多模态记忆在每个查询期间将相应的图像、结构化数据和网络引用保留为可寻址工件。编码接口在存储数据上执行生成的程序，实现结合多个工具结果的计算。这些机制共同支持获取、检查和组合多模态证据的迭代过程。在22个基准上使用八个开源和专有骨干进行评估，OpenVLHarness相对于匹配的无工具基线平均分数提高9.7-12.6分，包括Q

extra.description: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress on visual reasoning, yet many tasks require evidence that is difficult to obtain through internal reasoning alone: our controlled study on 22 benchmarks shows that simply increasing the inference budget of the base model yields only modest gains. Such tasks demand grounded perception, external knowledge, and numerical measurements obtained through heterogeneous tools, whose outputs must be made interpretable to the model and retained across reasoning steps. We introduce OpenVLHarness, a multimodal reasoning harness organized around a capability layer and persistent multimodal memory. The capability layer combines task-level tool interfaces with evidence rendering, providing consistent access to heterogeneous backends and converting their outputs into model-readable observations. Persistent multimodal memory retains the corresponding images, structured data, and web references as addressable artifacts throughout each query. A coding interface executes generated programs over stored data, enabling computations that combine results from multiple tools. Together, these mechanisms support an iterative process of acquiring, inspecting, and composing multimodal evidence. Evaluated on 22 benchmarks with eight open and proprietary backbones, OpenVLHarness improves average scores by 9.7-12.6 points over matched no-tool baselines, including +11.2 with Qwen3-VL-8B, +9.7 with Kimi K3, and +9.9 with GPT-6 Astra. With GPT-6 Luna at medium reasoning effort, OpenVLHarness outperforms the base model, Codex, and Visual Sketchpad at maximum effort by 7.7-8.5 points while incurring at most 37% of their model-token cost.

items.title: Reinforcement Learning with Visually Attributable On-Policy Self-Distillation
items.title_zh: 具有视觉可归因性的同策略自蒸馏强化学习
items.summary_zh: 具有可验证奖励的多模态强化学习（RLVR）提供可靠的任务级监督，但对视觉推理中定位错误提供的指导有限。同策略自蒸馏（OPSD）通过来自具有以证据为中心视觉视图的特权教师的密集token级校正来补充这种监督。然而，所得校正可能将视觉证据与由语言先验、响应风格或特权视图本身引起的非视觉偏移相混淆。我们将此现象形式化为特权校正污染：当token级校正的更新方向不能一致地归因于特权视觉证据时，该校正被污染。因此，直接蒸馏被污染的校正可能强化错误的token级更新。为解决此问题，我们提出具有视觉可归因同策略自蒸馏的强化学习，一种证据一致的范式，用基于视觉证据的特权token级校正增强任务级RLVR监督。我们用视觉归因门控（VAG）实例化该范式，它使用验证器导出的优势作为优化锚点，并针对证据存在与证据退化教师视图之间的对比验证每个特权校正。通过仅接纳由该视觉对比方向性支持的校正，VAG保留视觉接地的指

extra.description: Multimodal reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides reliable task-level supervision, yet offers limited guidance for localizing errors in visual reasoning. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) complements this supervision with dense token-level corrections from a privileged teacher equipped with an evidence-centered visual view. However, the resulting corrections may conflate visual evidence with non-visual shifts induced by linguistic priors, response style, or the privileged view itself. We formalize this phenomenon as privileged-correction contamination: a token-level correction is contaminated when its update direction cannot be consistently attributed to the privileged visual evidence. Directly distilling contaminated corrections may therefore reinforce erroneous token-level updates. To address this issue, we propose reinforcement learning with visually attributable on-policy self-distillation, an evidence-consistent paradigm that augments task-level RLVR supervision with privileged token-level corrections grounded in visual evidence. We instantiate this paradigm with Visual-Attribution Gating (VAG), which uses the verifier-derived advantage as the optimization anchor and validates each privileged correction against the contrast between evidence-present and evidence-degraded teacher views. By admitting only corrections directionally supported by this visual contrast, VAG preserves visually grounded guidance while suppressing inconsistent residuals. Experiments across six visual reasoning benchmarks show that VAG consistently outperforms GRPO and OPSD methods, establishing new state-of-the-art average performance.

items.title: Where is Physical RSI capability from? An Observational Scaling Law of LLM-as-policy
items.title_zh: 物理RSI能力从何而来？LLM作为策略的观察性缩放定律
items.summary_zh: 在本文中，我们系统研究了物理递归自我改进的机制、缩放行为和泛化。我们引入PhysRSI-eval，通过五轴指标量化物理RSI：首次尝试性能、效率、成功、预算和从失败中改进。不同VLM在固定交互预算下在18个操作任务上被评估。实验结果分析引出物理桶假说：不同能力可能约束改进的不同部分。五轴指标还区分了公共基准平均值接近的系统，并表明高分不一定伴随早期或高效增益。我们从两个角度研究观察性缩放：从VLM智能体的公共能力预测其相对性能，以及从早期物理反馈预测后期进展。总之，这些分析询问智能体能多快和多远地改进。此外，我们进行工作空间干预，然后分析改进留下了什么。移除历史降低后期成功率，冻结工作空间在未见布局上仍然有用，三个跨任务案例更早实现成功。结果表明场景特定适应和可重用经验可以共存。

extra.description: In this paper, we systematically investigate the mechanisms, scaling behavior, and generalization of physical Recursive self-improvement. We introduce PhysRSI-eval to quantify physical RSI through a five-axis metric: First-Attempt Performance, Efficiency, Success, Budget and Improvement from failure. Different VLMs are evaluated on 18 manipulation tasks under a fixed interaction budget. The analysis of experimental results motivates the Physical Barrel Hypothesis: different capabilities may constrain different parts of improvement. The five-axis metrics also distinguish systems with close public benchmark averages and show that high scores need not come with early or efficient gains. We study observational scaling from two perspectives: predicting the relative performance of VLM agents from their public capabilities, and forecasting later progress from early physical feedback. Together, these analyses ask how quickly and how far an agent can improve. Moreover, we conduct workspace interventions and then analyze what improvement leaves behind. Removing history reduces late-round success, frozen workspaces remain useful on unseen layouts, and three cross-task cases achieve success earlier. The results suggest that scene-specific adaptation and reusable experience can coexist.

items.title: WeAct: Dynamic Weight Switching as Agent Actions
items.title_zh: WeAct：动态权重切换作为智能体动作
items.summary_zh: 长时程智能体必须从交错轨迹中学习异构能力。更新共享参数以学习新能力可能降低先前获得的能力，导致灾难性遗忘。随着轨迹展开，不同阶段可能需要不同能力，然而传统联合训练和静态适配器合并在整个执行过程中保持固定参数配置。我们介绍WeAct（权重级内部动作），它在冻结骨干上训练独立的能力特定LoRA适配器，并将适配器选择添加到智能体的动作空间。这些内部动作使用模型的原生工具调用接口在共享上下文中按需组合能力。在八个深度研究基准上，Qwen3-32B配合WeAct相对于完全微调对应物平均准确率提高6.2%，尽管使用更少计算，相对于最强的静态LoRA合并方法提高27.5%。WeAct还支持模块化持续适应，通过添加新的代码计算适配器扩展智能体能力并更新现有写作适配器以提高报告质量。两项更新均保持骨干和其他适配器不变，支持智能体中的模块化持续适应。

extra.description: Long-horizon agents must learn heterogeneous capabilities from interleaved trajectories. Updating shared parameters to learn new capabilities can degrade previously acquired ones, resulting in catastrophic forgetting. As a trajectory unfolds, different stages may require different capabilities, yet conventional joint training and static adapter merging maintain a fixed parameter configuration throughout execution. We introduce WeAct (Weight-level Internal Actions), which trains independent capability-specific LoRA adapters over a frozen backbone and adds adapter selection to the agent's action space. These internal actions use the model's native tool-calling interface for on-demand capability composition in a shared context. Across eight deep-research benchmarks, Qwen3-32B with WeAct improves average accuracy by 6.2% relative to full fine-tuning counterparts despite using less compute, and by 27.5% relative to the strongest static LoRA-merging method. WeAct also supports modular continual adaptation, by adding a new code computation adapter to expand the agent's capabilities and updating the existing writing adapter to improve report quality. Both updates leave the backbone and other adapters unchanged, supporting modular continual adaptation in agents.

items.title: LatComm: Reusable Context Compression for Latent Communication between Large Language Models
items.title_zh: LatComm：大语言模型间潜在通信的可重用上下文压缩
items.summary_zh: 组合多个大语言模型（LLM）的系统通常为许多问题使用一个上下文。当上下文作为文本在模型间传递时，接收模型为每个问题重新处理其所有token。避免此成本需要一种紧凑、可在问题间重用且可被不同LLM读取的上下文表示。现有压缩和潜在通信方法各自仅提供其中部分特性。我们介绍LatComm，一种潜在通信接口，通过将编码与读取分离来提供全部三项：上下文在没有问题的情况下编码一次，接收方为每个问题选择读取什么。一个冻结的上下文编码器LLM将上下文压缩为固定大小的数据包并发送给不同的冻结接收器LLM，后者通过交叉注意力读取该数据包，门控从其提示计算。在12个多项选择问答数据集上，LatComm相对于单向量基线平均准确率提高最多10.2分。在QuALITY上，它将接收器输入减少57倍，并回答文章问题快3倍。

extra.description: Systems that combine several large language models (LLMs) often use one context for many questions. When the context is passed between models as text, the receiving model processes all of its tokens again for every question. Avoiding this cost requires a context representation that is compact, reusable across questions, and readable by a different LLM. Existing compression and latent communication methods each provide only some of these properties. We introduce LatComm, a Latent Communication interface that provides all three by separating encoding from reading: the context is encoded once without the question, and the receiver selects what to read for each question. A frozen context encoder LLM compresses the context into a fixed-size packet and sends it to a different frozen receiver LLM, which reads the packet through cross-attention, with gates computed from its prompt. On 12 multiple-choice question-answering datasets, LatComm improves average accuracy over single-vector baselines by up to 10.2 points. On QuALITY, it reduces the receiver's input by 57x and answers the questions of an article 3x faster.

items.title: Kronecker Delta Rule for Long Context Linear Attention
items.title_zh: 长上下文线性注意力的克罗内克 delta 规则
items.summary_zh: 我们提出KronLSTM，一种基于克罗内克Delta规则的线性注意力架构，这是一种用于关联矩阵记忆的新更新规则。KronLSTM扩展了xLSTM家族，具有记忆修正机制，可校正目标关联，同时仅沿矩阵空间中的单一方向修改记忆。与delta规则更新相比，这种微创记忆修正减少了对先前存储信息的干扰，使其特别适合长上下文语言建模。所得记忆动态可以数学描述为收敛到稳态分布的马尔可夫链，而记忆矩阵的期望范数在整个输入序列中保持均匀有界。因此，KronLSTM确保稳定的记忆动态，无需对记忆状态额外的归一化和稳定机制。实验表明，KronLSTM与现有线性注意力架构（包括(Gated) DeltaNet家族模型）具有竞争力，并且通常优于它们，在长上下文基准上表现尤其强劲。这些结果确立克罗内克Delta规则作为循环线性注意力架构中稳定关联记忆的有效且可分析的基础。我们的代码（https://github.com

extra.description: We propose KronLSTM, a linear attention architecture based on the Kronecker Delta Rule, a novel update rule for associative matrix memories. KronLSTM extends the xLSTM family with a memory-revision mechanism that corrects targeted associations while modifying the memory only along a single direction in matrix space. This minimally invasive memory revision reduces interference with previously stored information compared with delta-rule updates, making it particularly well suited for long-context language modeling. The resulting memory dynamics can be mathematically described as a Markov chain that converges to a steady-state distribution, while the expected norm of the memory matrix remains uniformly bounded throughout the entire input sequence. Hence, KronLSTM ensures stable memory dynamics without requiring additional normalization and stabilization mechanisms for the memory state. Experiments show that KronLSTM is competitive with, and often outperforms, existing linear attention architectures, including models of the (Gated) DeltaNet family, with particularly strong performance on long context benchmarks. These results establish the Kronecker Delta Rule as an effective and analytically tractable foundation for stable associative memory in recurrent linear attention architectures. Our code (https://github.com/NX-AI/KronLSTM) and models (https://huggingface.co/collections/NX-AI/kronlstm) are open-source.

items.title: Targeting TMPRSS2-ERG Fusion-Driven Prostate Cancer using Novel HBS-α-Helicomimics
items.title_zh: 使用新型HBS-α-螺旋模拟物靶向TMPRSS2-ERG融合驱动的前列腺癌
items.summary_zh: 雄激素受体（AR）响应基因TMPRSS2与ERG之间的基因融合发生在大约50%的前列腺癌（PCa）中，从而通过异常ERG表达促进肿瘤发生。靶向转录因子-DNA界面仍然是巨大挑战，主要由于靶标结合过程中肽折叠相关的熵惩罚。在此，我们描述针对ERG-DNA识别界面的氢键替代（HBS）约束α-螺旋模拟物的结构指导设计和临床前评估。ERG-DNA复合物的结构分析揭示DNA结合诱导识别螺旋H4从约2.5个螺旋圈伸长到4.0个螺旋圈。为稳定生物活性构象，我们引入N端HBS大环，引入D363E和S366E突变以增强DNA结合和结构稳定性，并添加双NLS-TAT标签以促进细胞递送。生化和细胞实验表明，先导化合物ERG螺旋模拟物竞争性抑制ERG与ETS基序结合，破坏ERG与AR和其他辅因子的关联，导致ERG转录活性受抑制。染色质免疫沉淀-qPCR证实ERG在经典靶基因调控区域的占据减少，伴随ERG驱动转录程

extra.description: Gene fusions between the androgen receptor (AR)-responsive gene TMPRSS2 and ERG occur in approximately 50% of prostate cancers (PCa), thereby promoting tumorigenesis through aberrant ERG expression. Therapeutic targeting of transcription factor-DNA interfaces remains a formidable challenge, largely owing to the entropic penalty associated with peptide folding during target engagement. Here, we describe the structure-guided design and preclinical evaluation of hydrogen-bond surrogate (HBS)-constrained alpha-helicomimics targeting the ERG-DNA recognition interface. Structural analysis of ERG-DNA complex revealed that DNA binding induces elongation of recognition helix H4 from approximately 2.5 to 4.0 helical turns. To stabilize the bioactive conformation, we incorporated an N-terminal HBS macrocycle, introduced D363E and S366E mutations to enhance DNA binding and structural stability, and added dual NLS-TAT tags to facilitate cellular delivery. Biochemical and cellular assays demonstrated that the lead compound, ERG helicomimics, competitively inhibited ERG binding to ETS motifs, disrupted ERG association with AR and other cofactors, leading to suppressed ERG transcriptional activity. Chromatin immunoprecipitation-qPCR confirmed reduced ERG occupancy at regulatory regions of canonical target genes, accompanied by downregulation of ERG-driven transcriptional programs. ERG helicomimics also reduced proliferation, migration, and invasion in ERG-positive PCa cells. In a murine xenograft model of TMPRSS2-ERG-positive PCa, systemic ERG helicomimics treatment suppressed tumor growth without overt toxicity and reduced Ki-67 expression compared with the designated control peptide. Collectively, our findings support HBS-constrained ERG helicomimics as a rational strategy for targeting ERG-driven PCa and warrant further therapeutic optimization.

items.title: Growth costs of protein allocation in models of growing cells
items.title_zh: 生长细胞模型中蛋白质分配的生长成本
items.summary_zh: 微生物生长取决于细胞如何在竞争功能间分配其有限蛋白质组。尽管许多蛋白质表达接近最大化生长的水平，但偏离这些最优值很常见，并可能施加显著适应度成本。建模次优蛋白质分配的生长成本仍然具有挑战性，因为蛋白质表达通过多种相互作用机制影响生长，包括生物合成需求、酶动力学和细胞密度限制。在此，我们使用生长平衡分析（GBA）分析这些效应，这是一种非线性框架，从基本细胞约束预测粗粒度微生物模型的稳态生长和生物量组成。这些模型预测的最优生物量组成不仅包括蛋白质浓度，还包括通过非线性速率定律饱和酶所需的反应物浓度，从而捕获比传统线性资源分配模型更复杂的资源权衡。使用这些GBA模型，我们计算单个蛋白质固定在次优水平时的最优生物量组成。所得次优蛋白质分配与生长率之间的关系与细菌中的定性实验模式一致，生长效应取决于蛋白质功能（包括闲置蛋白质）、环境条件、毒性副产物和替代反应。这些结果表明一种实用且可处理的方法来建模

extra.description: Microbial growth depends on how cells allocate their limited proteome among competing functions. Although many proteins are expressed near levels that maximize growth, deviations from these optima are common and can impose substantial fitness costs. Modeling the growth costs of suboptimal protein allocation remains challenging because protein expression influences growth through multiple interacting mechanisms, including biosynthetic demands, enzyme kinetics, and limits on cellular density. Here we analyze these effects using growth balance analysis (GBA), a nonlinear framework that predicts steady-state growth and biomass composition of coarse-grained microbial models from basic cellular constraints. The optimal biomass compositions predicted for these models include not only protein concentrations but also the reactant concentrations required to saturate enzymes through nonlinear rate laws, thereby capturing more complex resource trade-offs than in conventional linear resource allocation models. Using these GBA models, we compute optimal biomass compositions with individual proteins fixed at suboptimal levels. The resulting relationships between suboptimal protein allocation and growth rate are consistent with qualitative experimental patterns in bacteria, with growth effects depending on protein function (including idle proteins), environmental conditions, toxic byproducts, and alternative reactions. These results indicate a practical and tractable approach for modeling growth costs arising from suboptimal protein allocation, and suggest a basis for predictive modeling in metabolic engineering and synthetic biology.

items.title_zh: 董明珠称格力技工学校禁止谈恋爱、头发不能太长，你觉得合理吗？这对学生而言是束缚还是保护？
items.summary_zh: 2026年10月19日，珠海市格力技工学校开学第一课，校长董明珠围绕校园日常和生活细节对首届新生提出纪律要求：“那天我到超市一看，一个橘子1.5块，那宰我们学生？这种超市是不允许在这开的。十几岁的娃娃讲谈恋爱，这是不允许的。”她还表示，看到学生头发很长，就请了专业的理发师队伍，周末在这里做义工，给学生剪头发。 董明珠还寄语新生：技能人才同样拥有多元选择，“培养张雪这样的也可以”。她称：“我们毕业以后回去可以当老板，卖格力、卖空调、卖冰箱、卖洗衣机、卖家用电器，可以有更多的空间和选择。” 董明珠认为文凭不等于能力，“我觉得文凭不文凭不重要。技工学校出来的学生我觉得不弱于大学文凭。格力人未来需要的人才是什么？从我们的总部到全国各地的基地，需要技术人才，懂技术，懂营销。” 格力技工学校开学第一课，校长董明珠现场定规矩：禁止谈恋爱，头发不能太长，不允许高价超市存在；寄语新生：技能人才同样拥有多元选

items.summary_zh: 燃油车时代，BBA（宝马、奔驰、奥迪）旗下中型车奥迪A6、宝马5系、奔驰E级等的地位无人撼动。今年以来，即便是热销车型也出现了月销零售未能过万的情况。国内上险量数据显示，今年9月，宝马3系、5系，奔驰C级、E级，奥迪A6L等主力轿车，叠加X3、GLC、Q5L等主流SUV，单车零售销量全部卡在万辆以下，其中卖得最好的宝马3系9975辆，距万辆只差25辆。这在过去数年中是一个罕见的现象。对照去年9月，这六款车零售销量全部过万。https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/-4VCc1Xq8vI2HR5f9V4TgA

items.summary_zh: 本来对令人心动的 offer 第八季很期待，想看厉害的医学生。 结果看了个片花我都懵了 1. 带教老师问怎么诊断，回答说「我盲猜」 2. 问「病人说没钱治疗怎么办」，回答「自己掏钱补上」（真的好善良，但是这好像哪里不太对…） 3. 病人到底是左腕还是右腕有问题啊？ 可能是片子剪辑的时候特地剪出了有冲突的部分，但是这些错误会不会太低级了呢？ 真的医学生会犯这些错误吗？是不是像评论说的，这是学硕和专硕的不同呢？

items.title: 长鑫科技股价跳水，市值跌破3万亿元，前三季度预赚 1300 多亿还推出回购，为什么股价反而大跌？
items.title_zh: 长鑫科技股价跳水，市值跌破3万亿元，前三季度预赚 1300 多亿还推出回购，为什么股价反而大跌？
items.summary_zh: 10月19日，长鑫科技股价大跌，一度跌超8%。截至发稿，跌幅收窄至6.29%，报42.19元/股，市值约为2.86万亿元。 消息面上，10月17日美股存储芯片股普跌，SK海力士、闪迪、西部数据跌超6%，美光跌5.63%。 长鑫科技公告称，预计2026年前三季度归属于上市公司股东的净利润为1310.00亿元-1325.00亿元，同比扭亏为盈。按此计算，公司Q3净利润预计533.95亿-548.95亿，Q2净利润528.43亿，据此计算，Q3净利润预计环比增长1%-3%。 此外，长鑫科技董事长朱一明提议，拟使用自有或自筹资金，通过上交所交易系统以集中竞价方式回购公司A股股份。回购资金总额不低于10亿元且不超过20亿元，回购股份拟用于员工股权激励、员工持股计划或减少注册资本，回购价格不高于董事会审议通过方案前30个交易日股票交易均价的150%，实施期限为自董事会或股东会审议通过之日起12个月内。

items.title: 中国留学生俄罗斯课堂披旭日旗后道歉且已被遣返，如何评价？他在俄罗斯当地及回国后可能面临哪些实质追责？
items.title_zh: 中国留学生俄罗斯课堂披旭日旗后道歉且已被遣返，如何评价？他在俄罗斯当地及回国后可能面临哪些实质追责？
items.summary_zh: 《环球时报》记者从莫斯科大学历史系学生处获悉，在该系中国留学生的集体请愿下，校方于10月19日下午召开专题座谈会，表示将尽快公布对这名陈姓学生的开除决定，并会通过学校官网以及社交媒体渠道公开事件经过和校方立场。 记者了解到，16日，在陈姓学生身披旭日旗风波进一步发酵之际，该系研一学生张某和大四学生苏某一同起草请愿书，要求院方启动调查程序，核实这名陈姓学生的相关行为。在该系多名中国留学生签字后，这份集体请愿书当天被提交给莫斯科大学历史系。针对请愿诉求，莫斯科大学历史系立即作出回应，定于19日下午召开专题座谈会，并透露16日已启动相关程序，对这名陈姓学生作遣返处理。据了解，该陈姓学生目前已被遣返。身披旭日旗中国留学生已被遣返，校方称将尽快公布开除决定；本人发布道歉视频：“这是一件很不对的事，是对祖国和人民的不尊重” 近日，莫斯科大学一名中国留学生在课堂身披旭日旗的相关画面在网络传播，引发舆论高

items.title: 法国爆发严重暴力骚乱，超50万人上街抗议，马克龙公开谴责，冲突的深层根源是什么？折射出法国怎样的危机？
items.title_zh: 法国爆发严重暴力骚乱，超50万人上街抗议，马克龙公开谴责，冲突的深层根源是什么？折射出法国怎样的危机？
items.summary_zh: △当地时间10月18日，法国总统马克龙发表电视讲话。 当地时间10月18日，法国总统马克龙发表电视讲话时，谴责17日法国多地发生的暴力事件。他强调，任何理由都不能为这些行为开脱。他呼吁不要将诉求表达与暴力混为一谈，并表示将对其中的违法行为追究法律责任。 马克龙向受暴力事件影响的执法人员、官员和商户表达声援。他称，总理勒科尔尼将于19日主持召开危机应对小组会议，尽快动员相关援助。同时，马克龙要求政府总结17日暴力事件教训，特别是加强信息收集和预判，确保此类事件不再发生。 马克龙还对青年群体的焦虑表示理解，宣布政府将在未来一周与学生、教师、工会等共同研究应对措施，回应青年群体关切。 他说，此次抗议活动反映出民众对生活成本和燃油价格的担忧。他宣布将于19日访问海湾国家，以确保法国能源供应。 当地时间17日，法国首都巴黎及多个城市爆发示威游行，抗议生活成本高涨，部分地区发生暴力冲突。法国内政部长努

items.title: 多家期刊发布拒绝 AI 参与撰写稿件的声明，称润色也不行，怎么看？学术规范与 AI 提效如何平衡？
items.title_zh: 多家期刊发布拒绝 AI 参与撰写稿件的声明，称润色也不行，怎么看？学术规范与 AI 提效如何平衡？
items.summary_zh: 最近，多家期刊宣布拒绝生成式人工智能参与写作稿件，包含人工智能润色。 如《五台山研究》编辑部2026年10月15日表示，近期，本刊在来稿审阅过程中，发现个别稿件存在较为明显的人工智能使用痕迹，主要表现为内容空泛、文字堆砌、逻辑脱节、论述重复，甚至存在篡改引文、虚构文献及杜撰史实等严重学术失范问题。这不仅降低了学术研究的质量与严肃性，也对编辑审读及专家评审工作造成了极大干扰。 为维护学术诚信，恪守学术规范，保障学术成果的原创性与真实性，《五台山研究》宣布：本刊坚决拒绝任何利用人工智能工具生成、改写、润色或翻译论文的稿件。作者应坚持独立思考、独立研究、独立写作，并对论文观点与论据材料的真实性与准确性承担全部责任。凡经核查发现违规使用人工智能工具，本刊将一律作退稿处理，并视情节限制或拒收该作者后续投稿。由此产生的一切责任由作者本人承担。 沈阳师范大学学报编辑部也于日前发布了《关于暂不接收生成式人

items.title: 如何看待模仿王源博主「王扁」被前经纪人用锤子击打头部约 10 分钟，双方有什么矛盾？
items.title_zh: 如何看待模仿王源博主「王扁」被前经纪人用锤子击打头部约 10 分钟，双方有什么矛盾？
items.summary_zh: 近日，网红王扁在重庆观音桥附近摆摊遭一名男子持械殴打受伤住院的消息在社交平台流传。 10月19日，王扁（简万军）代理律师受其委托就此事发布说明与澄清，律师称，17日晚上，王扁摆摊时，打人者张某携带刀具和锤子突然从王扁摊位的后部冲出，对王扁的头部进行击打，并一直追逐击打王扁，王扁的头部事后到医院缝了9针，左手手掌骨折，背部也受到多处伤害，此外王扁的一名粉丝为帮助阻拦打人者张某，头部也被张某打伤，伤势比较严重。 视频称，打人者张某此前与王扁有过合作，合作期间 ，张某以王扁的经纪人或王扁的法人自称，后因王扁账号被某平台认定涉嫌违规后遭注销，无法再发布的自媒体内容，因此王扁无法再持续获得收入，后来被迫到长沙摆摊，经营小吃，两人在此期间合作关系破裂。此后，张某突然转变方向，开始在多个平台注册自媒体账号，发布以曝光、抹黑王扁为主题的内容，并利用AI创作类似王扁的形象来进行内涵和攻击，王扁已对上述行为提

items.title: 水杯闹钟等被改成学生的「藏手机神器」热销，这种产品为什么有市场？背后反映出哪些问题？
items.title_zh: 水杯闹钟等被改成学生的「藏手机神器」热销，这种产品为什么有市场？背后反映出哪些问题？
items.summary_zh: 为了防止学生沉迷手机、影响学习和身心健康，不少中小学都有严格的手机管理规定。然而，学校想方设法管手机，一些商家却动起脑筋帮学生“藏手机”。水杯、台灯、闹钟，甚至饭盒、纸巾盒，都被改造成所谓的“藏手机神器”，有的商家还宣称能够躲避金属探测仪检查。 所谓的“藏手机神器”究竟是怎么回事？学校又该如何协调学生的手机使用需求与校园管理要求？ 记者在多个电商平台搜索“藏手机神器”等关键词发现，这些所谓的“藏手机神器”品类繁多，从水杯、仿真书本、闹钟，到台灯、饭盒、纸巾盒，都是学生日常生活中常见物品，价格从几十元到上百元不等。商品介绍中，“防金属探测器”“双层暗格”“防突击检查”“可以上锁”等是主要卖点。平台数据显示，部分单品月销量超过500件，一些商品的累计销量甚至超过4000件。 记者注 水杯、闹钟被改造成“藏手机神器” 商家、平台是否该担责？
